summary: Telefônica Brasil S.A. filed a Form 6-K reporting the minutes of a Fiscal Council meeting held on May 14, 2026. The council unanimously approved a proposal to declare Interest on Capital (IoC) of R$600,000,000 gross (R$0.18775779427 per share), net of 17.5% withholding tax. The record date is May 27, 2026; shares will trade ex-IoC thereafter. The net amount will be allocated to the mandatory minimum dividend for FY2026, payable by April 30, 2027. This is a routine capital return declaration, not a special-situation event. No acquisition, divestiture, or structural change is involved. The filing is a standard foreign private issuer report of an ordinary dividend-like payment.
